newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent softer amid rise in API stocks.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent softer amid rise in API stocks.

text.p: Brent crude futures in Asia were untraded at midday on Thursday, but was quoted rangebound to a tad lower from London's close due to a rise in American Petroleum Institute crude stocks, brokers said.
SIMEX Brent for July was indicated at 19.05/$19.28 per barrel, straddling IPE's close of $19.24.
Swaps Brent for July was quoted at $19.18/19.19 per barrel, down five cents from London overnight, which settled two cents higher at $19.23.
But brokers said the rise in the weekly API stocks were smaller than predicted, preventing levels from falling further.
The API stocks were expected to rise by three million barrels, but the actual increase was just 1.396 million.
July Brent futures was expected to see support at 19.00, brokers said.
NYMEX July crude last traded on the after-hours ACCESS system at $20.75, down four cents from New York's official close of $20.79.
